raw_text: An outside-view experiment was run in which a separate model (a Gemini reception specimen) read a cleaned inference and extracted facts from it. The revealing result was that the instrument faithfully extracted a superseded lexical "tension score" formula as a clean, well-quoted fact — the dead formula had outlived the code that used it and was still propagating through documentation into every bundle. This exposed a core weakness: an extraction pipeline will confidently record a retired claim as current truth unless something external checks it, which motivated building an adjudication layer that compares extracted claims against a named baseline outside the text itself.
